name: Sextans
introduction: is the Sextant, introduced by Johannes Hevelius in 1687 in memory of the sextant he lost when his observatory burned down in 1679. It is a faint constellation south of Leo.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Sextans contains the Sextans Dwarf, a faint satellite galaxy of the Milky Way, and the Spindle Galaxy, NGC 3115, a lens-shaped galaxy with a massive central black hole.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Sextantis](hip:49641) is a white giant about 430 light-years away. [Beta Sextantis](hip:51437) is a blue-white star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The COSMOS field, a deep survey of distant galaxies, lies in Sextans.
